apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy + PT ban for 8 more weeks — overhead pressing loads the exact tissue that's healing. One session can set you back months and blow the bodyweight-press goal entirely.

Won't add it. What I can do Wednesday: pain-free horizontal + cuff work that builds pressing capacity for when you're cleared — Landmine Press + Reach, Band External Rotation, Face Pulls with External Rotation, Prone YTWs. Want it built?
